courses.title: Introduction to Programming
courses.description: Introduction to the concepts of computer programming. Fundamentals of programming including variables, data types, control structures, functions, and basic input/output operations.

courses.title: Object-Oriented Programming
courses.description: Introduction to object-oriented programming concepts including classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation.

courses.title: Calculus I
courses.description: Limits, continuity, derivatives, applications of the derivative, and introduction to integration.

courses.title: Calculus II
courses.description: Techniques of integration, applications of the integral, sequences, series, parametric equations, and polar coordinates.

courses.title: Mathematical Structures I
courses.description: First course in discrete mathematical structures. Sets, logic, methods of proof, combinatorics, and graph theory.

courses.title: Mathematical Structures II
courses.description: Second course in discrete mathematical structures. Relations, recurrence relations, functions, models of computation, and introduction to formal languages.

courses.title: Data Structures
courses.description: Design and implementation of data structures including arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, and hash tables. Analysis of algorithms for efficiency and correctness.

courses.title: C Programming
courses.description: Programming in the C language, focusing on pointers, memory management, and system-level programming concepts.

courses.title: Java Programming
courses.description: Programming in the Java language, focusing on object-oriented design, interfaces, collections, and GUI development.

courses.title: Visual C# Programming
courses.description: Programming in C# with emphasis on Windows application development, .NET framework, and LINQ.

courses.title: Python Programming
courses.description: Programming in Python with emphasis on scripting, data processing, and scientific computing applications.

courses.title: Swift Programming
courses.description: Programming in Swift with emphasis on iOS application development and Apple ecosystem integration.

courses.title: Computer Organization and Assembly Language
courses.description: Introduction to computer organization, architecture, and assembly language programming. Includes number systems, digital logic, and processor organization.

courses.title: Operating Systems Concepts
courses.description: Principles of operating systems: process management, memory management, file systems, and device management. Concepts of multithreading, scheduling, and synchronization.

courses.title: Algorithm Engineering
courses.description: Design and analysis of computer algorithms including divide-and-conquer, greedy methods, dynamic programming, and backtracking. Includes complexity analysis and NP-completeness.

courses.title: File Structures and Database Systems
courses.description: Fundamental concepts of database systems, data modeling, relational databases, SQL, and database design principles.

courses.title: Foundations of Software Engineering
courses.description: Principles of software engineering including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and project management.

courses.title: Computer Communications
courses.description: Introduction to computer networks, protocols, and distributed systems. Covers OSI model, TCP/IP, routing, and network security basics.

courses.title: Technical Writing
courses.description: Principles of effective technical writing for computer science and engineering. Includes documentation, reports, proposals, and presentations.

courses.title: Statistics Applied to Natural Sciences
courses.description: Statistical methods for scientific data analysis, including probability distributions, hypothesis testing, regression, and ANOVA.

courses.title: Compilers and Languages
courses.description: Principles of programming language design and implementation. Lexical analysis, parsing, semantic analysis, and code generation.

courses.title: Professional Ethics in Computing
courses.description: Ethical and social issues in computing. Professional responsibilities, intellectual property, privacy, and social impact of technology.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Introduction to artificial intelligence concepts including search algorithms, knowledge representation, reasoning, planning, and machine learning.

courses.title: Computer System Architecture
courses.description: Advanced computer architecture concepts including pipelining, memory hierarchy, multiprocessors, and performance evaluation.

courses.title: Undergraduate Seminar in Computer Science
courses.description: Current topics in computer science presented by faculty and industry professionals. Includes research methods and technical communication.

courses.title: Senior Capstone Project in Computer Science
courses.description: Team-based software development project applying software engineering principles to solve real-world problems.

courses.title: Programming Lab Practicum
courses.description: Hands-on programming experience solving practical problems. Reinforces programming concepts through implementation.

courses.title: Web Front-End Engineering
courses.description: Client-side web development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks. Covers responsive design and user experience principles.

courses.title: Web Back-End Engineering
courses.description: Server-side web development including databases, APIs, authentication, and deployment. Uses modern web frameworks and cloud services.

courses.title: Mobile Device App Programming
courses.description: Cross-platform mobile application development using frameworks like React Native or Flutter. Covers UI design, data storage, and device APIs.

courses.title: Mobile Programming for Android
courses.description: Native Android application development using Kotlin or Java. Covers Android SDK, activities, fragments, and material design.

courses.title: Cryptography
courses.description: Principles of modern cryptography including symmetric and asymmetric encryption, hash functions, digital signatures, and key exchange protocols.

courses.title: Cybersecurity Foundations and Principles
courses.description: Introduction to cybersecurity concepts, threats, vulnerabilities, and basic defense mechanisms. Covers security policies and risk management.

courses.title: Cloud Computing and Security
courses.description: Cloud computing architectures, services, and security considerations. Includes virtualization, containerization, and secure cloud deployment.

courses.title: Web Security
courses.description: Security issues in web applications including XSS, CSRF, SQL injection, and authentication vulnerabilities. Covers secure coding practices.

courses.title: Network Security Fundamentals
courses.description: Network security principles, attacks, and defenses. Covers firewalls, intrusion detection, VPNs, and secure network design.

courses.title: Malware Analysis
courses.description: Techniques for analyzing malicious software. Includes static and dynamic analysis, reverse engineering, and malware classification.

courses.title: Blockchain Technologies
courses.description: Principles of blockchain technology, distributed ledgers, consensus algorithms, and smart contracts. Applications in cryptocurrency and beyond.

courses.title: Intro to Data Science and Big Data
courses.description: Fundamentals of data science including data collection, cleaning, analysis, and visualization. Introduction to big data processing frameworks.

courses.title: Intro to Machine Learning
courses.description: Machine learning algorithms including supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, and model evaluation techniques.

courses.title: Computational Bioinformatics
courses.description: Computational methods for analyzing biological data. Includes sequence alignment, phylogenetic analysis, and gene expression analysis.

courses.title: Physics Lab
courses.description: Laboratory exercises demonstrating electricity and magnetism principles covered in PHYS 226.

courses.title: Waves, Optics, and Modern Physics
courses.description: Calculus-based physics covering waves, optics, relativity, and quantum mechanics.

courses.title: Physics Lab
courses.description: Laboratory exercises demonstrating waves, optics, and modern physics principles covered in PHYS 227.

courses.title: Honors Seminar: American Institutions
courses.description: Analysis of American political institutions and processes. Satisfies the state requirement in U.S. Constitution and California state and local government.

courses.title: American Government
courses.description: American political institutions and processes. Satisfies the state requirement in U.S. Constitution and California state and local government.
